title: Detergents Regulation (EU) 2026/405

productGroups.notes: Adopted 2026-02-11, published in the OJ 2026-03-02. Nothing determinable yet. retentionYears is sourced: the Regulation requires 10 years after placing on the market, including in cases of insolvency.

notes: Two things worth keeping straight. First, the passport date is sourced: Art. 21(1), 'Before placing a detergent or end-user surfactant on the market, the manufacturer shall create a digital product passport for that product', applies from 23 September 2029 under Art. 37, which excepts only Art. 4(3) and (4). Two limits the date does not show. Art. 36(2) lets detergents and surfactants that comply with Regulation (EC) No 648/2004 be placed on the market until 22 September 2030 and made available until 23 September 2030, so the first year is a transition. And Art. 21(10) leaves the passport's technical requirements to an implementing act whose date of application may not be earlier than 18 months after its entry into force, save in duly justified cases, so an act that enters into force after 23 March 2028 cannot apply by the passport date. Second, detergents is a direct instrument, not an ESPR delegated act — it appears in the ESPR Art. 18 statutory priority list but was NOT selected into the 2025-2030 working plan, so no ESPR act is coming for it and this Regulation is the whole of its passport obligation. Consequential difference from every other instrument here: under this Regulation the passport replaces the EU declaration of conformity as the primary means of demonstrating compliance, so a defective passport costs an operator its conformity route rather than one disclosure among several.
